ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { transaction: correlationId, apiName: p("api.name"), apiVersion: p("api.version"), timestamp: now(), infoMessage: if (!isEmpty(payload.infoMessage)) payload.infoMessage else { statusCode: p("response.bad.request.code") as Number, statusMessage: p("response.bad.request.message"), errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default "") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default ""), errorDescription: error.detailedDescription default "" } }
